title: Maria Felda Alarkon
gist: A short staff bio page for a World Bank Education Global Practice consultant in the Philippines who supports institutional capacity and delivery systems for World Bank-financed education reforms, including with the Department of Education and Bangsamoro ministries.

insights.claim: The World Bank's Education Global Practice in the Philippines deploys institutional-strengthening consultants to support implementation capacity and delivery systems of World Bank-financed education reforms across national and subnational levels.

insights.so_what: Signals World Bank emphasis on implementation capacity, not just financing, in Philippine education lending.
